approach: MIPS R3000A code translated to C at build time and linked with an HLE PS1 runtime (GTE, software or OpenGL ES GPU, SPU, CD-ROM); hand-written render asm is compiled into interpreter-exact C regions.
notes: Menus and races play at full speed with music and XA audio. 4x internal resolution with sub-pixel vertices, 16:9 or full-window widescreen. Two players with two controllers (split screen). Not yet: FMV (MDEC), analog pad, 3-4 players (multitap).
